name: ArchiveRow
description: One archived row. Filled checkmark-circle on the left, bold title (NOT struck through), trash icon on the right. Meta block underneath is vertical: 'Added: <ts>', 'Done: <ts>', and (if dueDate existed) 'Due:' + a colored due badge. A faint monospace debug task id sits below.

dueLabel.description: Full label shown inside the due pill, e.g. 'Due · Sep 01, 2026'.
